title: Lynq and ZeroBeta Connect Tokenized Treasuries to Collateral Workflows
why_it_matters: The connection links collateral instructions, margin monitoring and settlement on one rail, but the absence of disclosed users or transaction volumes leaves actual adoption unproven.
caption:
RWA WIRE // TOKENIZED TREASURIES

Lynq and ZeroBeta Connect Tokenized Treasuries to Collateral Workflows

ZeroBeta's BlueShift risk platform has certified connectivity to Lynq, enabling eligible tokenized Treasury holdings to support borrowing and trading margin while interest continues to accrue.
